description: Manitoba Road Network is a series of datasets listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. Manitoba Transportation and Infrastructure's road network, current to 2022. Created by Manitoba Infrastructure, the 2022 Manitoba Road Network comprises four years of updates.Previous exports were based on the now legacy Control Sections. In this updated road network, the department adapts an Advanced Linear Referencing System (ALRS) with an Linear Referencing Method based on routes. Coverage: Government of Manitoba. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Manitoba | Gouvernement du Manitoba. Its tags are manitoba, road, network, Province of Manitoba, Manitoba Government. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OpenMB Information and Data Use License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
